alt: Four photos in images/, including the 1927 Solvay conference and a newly added Carter_welcomes_Reagan.jpg, are split into faces with face_recognition (dlib) and stored as 128-d points in the face_embeddings collection in Qdrant, 36 faces with 29 from Solvay; querying with einplanck3.jpg finds Einstein's face in the Solvay photo at a distance around 0.46, with its bounding box.

run.note: Detect, embed and index every face in images/
